title: Help teams turn the strategy into their own plans
summary: Teams need to see how their work links to the strategy. Help them set their own goals and plans from it, rather than handing down a list of tasks.

beginner: Walk each team through the strategy and the bets.
Ask each team how their work could move the bets forward.
Help them set goals that link to the bets.
Check the goals add up across teams.
intermediate: Use objectives and key results to link team goals to the strategy.
Spot gaps and overlaps between teams.
Agree how teams will report progress against the bets.
experienced: Run the cascade across many teams in one planning cycle.
Give teams problems to solve, not features to build.
Adjust the strategy when teams find it doesn't work in practice.

toolExamples.jira: Link team goals to strategic initiatives.
toolExamples.confluence: Publish team goals next to the strategy.

definitionOfDone: Every team has goals linked to the bets
pitfalls: Team goals that don't add up

sources.title: Objectives and key results play (Atlassian Team Playbook)
